IIT Mandi Project associate/ JRF Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Mandi Project associate/ JRF Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Associate/JRF.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate/JRF post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate/JRF post?
faq.answer: The offered salary is Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA (as applicable).

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in CSE, ECE, EE, MCA is required, preferably with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Mandi located?
faq.answer: IIT Mandi is located in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 175075.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates (if applicable).
